$description: Components the web shell implements. Every component is one .dc.html fed its resolved visuals (design) and props (config + core); the shell (Backdrop Nav Skeleton.dc.html) only arranges instances (frontLayer: FrontLayer · bottomSheet / sideSheet: NowPlayingSheet, UpNextSheet · peekCard: PeekCard · layer pages: DededeLayer, AccountLayer). Interactive ones share interactive.js (state, state layer, ripple, focus ring, base motions of design/components/interactive) and own their state keyed by slot path. appBar page form: AppBarPage (the page: fills, track list, scroll thumb) holding Bar (top row) + AppBarSheet (album info + bottom row). Variants (logo, caret, queueRow, drawerItem, localSearch, viewSwitch, choiceChips, suggestionRow, errorState) are drawn by their parent's DC (or their own where listed in docs/NOTES.md). Symbols: Material Symbols Rounded (variable font).
